text:
ram: morning — noticed surge of Pending GPU pods in ap-northeast1 around 02:14 UTC, likely binpacking fragmentation after the rack balancing job last night
emily: saw it too. packing heatmap shows many single-GPU slots left, gangs can't find adjacent NVLink slots
oscar: can you paste the sample pod status?
ram: quick dump:
```kubectl get pods -n prod -l release=lr-train -o wide | egrep 'Pending|NAME'
NAME                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS  AGE
lr-train-12-x       0/4     Pending   0         12s
lr-train-12-y       0/2     Pending   0         10s
```
infra-bot: autoscaler: added 2 nodes in ap-northeast1-b at 02:09 UTC (policy: spread-cost)
sasha: spread-cost is making things worse for NVLink co-allocation — it's distributing single GPUs across racks
emily: exact problem: scheduler can place a gang only if 2 slots co-located in same nvlink-group; otherwise it rejects and keeps pending
oscar: any evictions/taint events?
ram: yes — warmpool drain taints then kubelet evicted one pod with reason "nodeAffinity"
```W 02:11 scheduler: binding failed: requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution match failure
E 02:12 kubelet: Evicted pod lr-train-12-x due to NodeAffinity
```
emily: short term: suggest switching autoscaler policy to zone-local for 30m and pause the rack-balancer job to let binpacker coalesce
sasha: +1. also propose lowering strictAffinity for tiny_shard jobs from 0.95 to 0.7 while we gauge cross-AZ perf impact
oscar: lowering helps packing but could increase NVLink-less distributed comm cost. need telemetry: network egress and cross-host latency
infra-bot: action created: INF-3411 - toggle autoscaler -> zone-local for ap-northeast1; run coalescer simulation (assignee: emily)
deploy-bot: autoscaler policy set to zone-local in ap-northeast1 by emily at 02:20 UTC
ram: after flip pending dropped 5 -> 0 within 8m, evictions stopped
emily: monitoring egress; 10m window shows ~6% bump in inter-az egress for training jobs, within budget for now
sasha: follow-ups: file scheduler PR to make binpacker NVLink-aware (prefer co-located group placement) and add a scheduling reason tag on pod events for blocked_by_nvlink
oscar: agree. also add alert: pending_gang_pods_by_reason > 3 for 5m
ram: I'll open INF-3412 for arch work, include perf sims and rollout plan
emily: thanks — leaving autoscaler zone-local for the 2 hour window, will revert if cost delta exceeds 15% or pending spikes again
sasha: noted. :thumbsup:
